scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap after a fresh clone. The backend (dev:db:*, test:backend:db, gen:types) also needs Docker running and the Supabase CLI on PATH.
scripts.//-- db --: Local Supabase stack (apps/backend, Postgres 17): API 54721, DB 54722, Studio 54723, Mailpit 54724. Needs Docker. Migrations + pgTAP tests in apps/backend/supabase.
scripts.//-- web --: SvelteKit 3 (Svelte 5) prerendered marketing site on port 7790 (docs/STACK.md). Does not use the backend; every page is static HTML.
scripts.//-- test --: Vitest unit tests beside the modules they cover, the root-scripts guard, and pgTAP (schema, invariants, RLS). test:backend:db needs dev:db:up first.
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:backend:db
scripts.//-- gen --: Regenerate apps/backend/supabase/database.types.ts from the live local schema (needs dev:db:up). Commit the result.
